original_poem:
அழகிய தமிழ் மகன்
அன்னையின் கண்ணீர் நதி
மனத்தை ஆளும் ஆற்றல்
உள்ளத்தில் கொண்டே உளர்மால்.
translated_poem:
The beautiful Tamil youth
The river of a mother’s tears
The strength that rules the mind
Residing in the heart, it sways.

stanzas.loss_note: உளர்மால் carries the Alvar-tradition sense of being seized or overwhelmed by divine or deep inner force — rendered as 'it sways' which loses this weight of possession and the Vaishnava devotional resonance of மால் as an epithet of Vishnu.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: a mother's accumulated sorrow flowing as an unstoppable civilisational grief
the Tamil youth's identity as a sovereign force over inner life

cultural_entities.translation_note: Rendered as 'Tamil youth' — preserves the cultural identity marker but loses the filial-civilisational weight of மகன் as son of the Tamil mother-tongue tradition.
மால் is an epithet of Vishnu in Alvar devotional poetry; its presence here gives the line a devotional-possession resonance entirely absent in 'it sways'.
